decisions.reason: The GK 2.0 high-resolution generation was launched prominently on the home page, sits at the core of the firm's established offer and carries heavy development investment, so management will stay committed to it.
The Numbering module was publicly announced as an expansion of the software portfolio for variable-data printing and fits the announced serialization direction, so it will be kept.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the core inkjet and ink expertise and supports the firm's consumables business, so dropping it would contradict earlier investments.
CodeScan has its own page, is the successor to PharmaScan and supports the traceability strategy at low running cost, so management will keep it even though its revenue impact is unclear.
Inline code verification is central to the announced end-to-end traceability and serialization direction, which strongly justifies continuing it.
The layout design software was promoted on the home page and underpins the firm's common operation across systems, so it remains part of the portfolio.
